name: hud-reo
label: HUD FHA single family REO inventory
notes: Bank owned in the truest sense: HUD took these back after paying an FHA claim.
Free, national, no key. Change the where clause to your state.
This layer is thin. It publishes address and case number, not price or beds,
so pair it with the county parcel layer to get owner and value data.
Run 'gf discover hud-reo' before trusting the field mapping.
